headline: Intel plans $15 billion share sale as turnaround rally lifts stock
summary: Intel on Monday said it is planning to raise $15 billion through a share sale, as it looks to fund the ‌costly build-out of its chip contract manufacturing business by cashing in ‌on a stock surge fueled by its turnaround efforts.  Once a dominant force in the global chip industry, ​Intel is investing heavily in new facilities and advanced packaging capabilities as it seeks to challenge industry leaders such as TSMC in contract chip manufacturing.  The stock has ‌nearly tripled this year, outperforming ⁠rivals AMD and TSMC and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index nearly 75% rise.
